Container.Name: gbrain-aio
Container.Overview:
Vanilla GBrain all-in-one for Unraid. One s6 container runs PostgreSQL 17 + pgvector, the official GBrain HTTP server, a Caddy TLS reverse proxy, the GBrain job supervisor, and in-container maintain (autopilot every 30 minutes, nightly dream, weekly doctor). Postgres listens on loopback only and is never published. Agents connect only through the MCP endpoint, never to Postgres.
First run: 1. Set POSTGRES_PASSWORD (alphanumeric) and GBRAIN_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN (32+ chars, alphanumeric + _-). Generate a token with: head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d '+/=' | head -c 48 2. Set GBRAIN_LAN_BIND to your Unraid host LAN IP and GBRAIN_PUBLIC_URL to https://<that IP>:3132. Both are local-network only. 3. Create an empty brain folder (e.g. /mnt/user/my-brain) and set Brain Path to it. Set Source Name to the folder's name (e.g. my-brain). 4. Start the container, then open https://<lan>:3132/admin/ and paste the bootstrap token. The container inits the brain, git-inits if needed, registers the source, and queues a sync. No docker exec required. 5. Trust the generated CA once (caddy/certs/ca.pem) on any phone or WebView.
Advanced users can point OLLAMA_BASE_URL at a local Ollama for embeddings and openai-compat chat, or add a provider API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, Voyage) in the advanced fields. Leave optional URL, budget, and toggle fields empty to keep them off.

Container.Requires: Docker with Compose. A LAN IP you control. Optional: a local Ollama at http://<lan>:11434 for embeddings and chat.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Published HTTPS port (Caddy).

Config.Name: Postgres Data
Config.Description: Persistent PostgreSQL data.

Config.Name: GBrain Home
Config.Description: GBrain config, OAuth secrets, runtime.env.

Config.Name: Caddy Certs
Config.Description: Persistent TLS certs and CA.

Config.Name: Brain Path
Config.Description: Host path to the brain markdown repo. This is the folder GBrain reads/writes as its knowledge base. It should be an empty folder (or a git repo) that GBrain will initialize. The folder name must match the Source Name below.

Config.Name: Postgres User
Config.Description: Postgres superuser. Keep gbrain.

Config.Name: Postgres Password
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Alphanumeric only (A-Za-z0-9). Secret. Example: mypass123. Generate: head -c 16 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d '+/=' | head -c 16

Config.Name: Postgres DB
Config.Description: Postgres database name. Keep gbrain.

Config.Name: LAN Bind
Config.Description: Your Unraid host LAN IP (e.g. 192.168.1.50). The container binds HTTPS to this IP. This is local-network only, not a public address.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Local HTTPS origin clients use. Must be https://<your LAN IP>:3132 (same IP as LAN Bind). Local-only. Example: https://192.168.1.50:3132

Config.Name: Admin Bootstrap Token
Config.Description: First /admin login token. Must be 32+ chars, alphanumeric + _-. Secret. Generate: head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d '+/=' | head -c 48

Config.Name: Source Name
Config.Description: Name of the mounted brain source. MUST equal the basename of the Brain Path folder. Example: if Brain Path is /mnt/user/my-brain, Source Name is my-brain.

Config.Name: Brain UID
Config.Description: UID for the brain bind mount. Unraid default is 99 (nobody). Keep 99 unless you know otherwise.

Config.Name: Brain GID
Config.Description: GID for the brain bind mount. Unraid default is 100 (users). Keep 100 unless you know otherwise.

Config.Name: Ollama Base URL
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for embeddings + chat. Point at your local Ollama. Example: http://192.168.1.50:11434/v1 (replace with your Ollama host IP). Leave empty to skip local Ollama.

Config.Name: Ollama API Key
Config.Description: Ollama API key. 'ollama' is the default for a local Ollama. Only needed if your Ollama requires a key.

Config.Name: Together API Key
Config.Description: Together-compatible key. GBrain routes chat/dream/think through the Ollama /v1 endpoint using this key. For a local Ollama, 'ollama' works. Set a real Together key only if you route through Together.

Config.Name: Chat Model
Config.Description: Chat model name used when OLLAMA_BASE_URL is set. Written as together:<this name>. Leave the default unless you know another model. Empty Ollama URL means no chat model (keyword/embed-or-skip).

Config.Name: Brain Git Push URL
Config.Description: Optional. After a successful autopilot-cycle, push the mounted brain to this remote. Empty = off. Do not point a test copy at a live canonical remote. The token is not stored in the remote URL.

Config.Name: Brain Git Push Token
Config.Description: Optional. Masked token for Brain Git Push URL. Empty = unauthenticated push. Never pasted into git remote -v.

Config.Name: Doctor Remediate Max USD
Config.Description: Optional. Weekly doctor exam always runs. Set a number to also run gbrain doctor --remediate --max-usd N for that run's estimate. Empty = exam only. Not a weekly wallet.

Config.Name: Skillopt Enabled
Config.Description: Optional. Empty = off. Set 1/true/yes/on to enable cycle.skillopt.enabled.

Config.Name: Nightly Quality Probe
Config.Description: Optional. Empty = off. Set 1/true/yes/on to enable autopilot.nightly_quality_probe.enabled.

Config.Name: Parser Probe Enabled
Config.Description: Optional. Empty = off. Set 1/true/yes/on to enable autopilot.conversation_parser_probe.enabled.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Enables Claude models for chat/think. Secret.

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Enables OpenAI models for chat/embeddings. Secret.

Config.Name: Google Gemini API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Enables Google Gemini models. Secret.

Config.Name: DeepSeek API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Enables DeepSeek models. Secret.

Config.Name: Groq API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Enables Groq models. Secret.

Config.Name: Voyage API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Enables Voyage embeddings/rerank. Secret.
